basis: Cross-view study from supplied figurine photos; camera estimates and sculpted sections, not official dimensions.

blush.projection: local tangent disk projected onto cheek along its surface normal

ear.surface: Broad dark inner bowl partly hidden by crown; the visible half-moon comes from head occlusion, not an eyebrow-shaped paint stripe.
ear.rootInsetNote: Lowered and inset after same-view comparison to bury the lower rim in the crown; camera estimates retained for visual checking.

cameraFit.limitations: Inherited R04 camera estimates, not re-fitted or calibrated for R06. No precise pure-side/rear reference. Former landmark errors do not validate this revision.

capProfile: elliptical closure at crown and chin
revision: R06 head sections retained. R07 corrects ear bowl and root occlusion, tangent-space cheek circles, warm orange-brown albedo and neutral review lighting.
